title: No edge from vertex one
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols, bit string $x$, and nonnegative integers $s,v$, there is no edge from vertex $1$ to vertex $v$ for input $x$ and radius $s$.
